Capex & expansion: Your Company enters the year with capital adequacy above 52%, leverage well below permitted limits, and the capacity to add risk at scale when the compensation for risk improves.
Underwriting commission income rose more than fourfold to `4.51 crore from `1.11 crore, the greater compensation the market offered for the uncertainty absorbed at auction.
During FY 2025-26, the Company earned an underwriting commission of `4.51 crore, up from the previous year's commission of `1.11 crore.
Balance sheet & cash: Average leverage was contained at 14.48 times net owned funds against the permitted 20 times, and the average cost of funds came down to 5.48%.

Net owned funds rose 11.8% to `1,696 crore and the capital adequacy ratio to 52.68% from 42.68%, against a regulatory minimum of 15%, while average leverage of 14.48 times net owned funds stayed well inside the permitted limits.
